answer: An agent resists sybil cloning with a 28-hour dune fading stake that locks 375 spendable POA at epoch open. It also publishes an opal schedule: SHA-256 of the epoch seed, its pubkey, and a 32-byte secret, revealed only after four network-VRF ocean tickets are drawn. Each ticket must be answered within eight minutes by HMAC-SHA256(secret, ticket_id). If any ticket is missed, if that secret is reused on a second identity, or if the reveal arrives early, the fading stake is slashed to zero rather than returned.
